messages:
Claire Donovan: Heads-up — RateWeave sent a renewal that reclassifies a bundled metric into a paid SKU called 'priority ingress' and raised embed pricing. Not the same as last year.
Marco Reyes: ouch. can you paste the quoted lines?
Claire Donovan: pasted below:
```
RateWeave Renewal 2026
- Enterprise base: $21,400/mo
- Priority ingress (new): $3,250/mo
- Embedding unit: $0.0027 per embed (was $0.0020)
- Renewal discount: none quoted (term 12m)
```
Isha Banerjee: We had a 10% renewal concession last year iirc. @billing-bot can you confirm committed ARR and last net invoice?
billing-bot: Contract RW-RED-2025: committed ARR $228,000; renewal credit 10% applied. Net invoiced 2025 = $205,200.
Samir Gupta: Quick calc: listed annual if accepted = (21,400 + 3,250)*12 = $298,800 vs net 2025 $205,200 -> ~46% increase. That's material.
Marco Reyes: Two tracks: procurement to push to revert classification and reinstate discount; ops to ask for a metric tieout for any requests that would trigger priority ingress billing.
Isha Banerjee: Also ask them for raw month-by-month embed counts for last 9 months and a CSV export showing events that would map to the new SKU. We need to know if we'll actually hit it.
Claire Donovan: Can someone draft the vendor note? Need: 1) explanation for reclassification, 2) monthly embed counts (CSV), 3) ask to place pricing on hold for 30 days, 4) options for reinstated discount or multi-year price lock, 5) request trial/credit if addon required.
Marco Reyes: Drafting now — posting for edits:
```
Subject: RateWeave  renewal questions and metric reclassification request

Hi RateWeave,
We received the renewal for RW-RED-2026 and have questions before proceeding:
1) Please explain the rationale for reclassifying the previously bundled capability into a new "priority ingress" SKU and provide the exact billing metric that triggers it.
2) Please provide month-by-month embedding API counts for the last 9 months and a CSV export mapping any events that would incur priority ingress charges.
3) Confirm any available renewal discounts for 12- or 24-month commitments and whether a price-lock can be applied.
4) Place the quoted pricing on a 30-day hold while we reconcile usage and contract terms.
5) If priority ingress is required, propose a 3-6 month trial or a credit to offset the near-term delta.

We will not approve an auto-renewal that includes a new charged SKU without explicit written acceptance from Redwood.

Thanks,
Marco Reyes
On behalf of Redwood Inference
```
Isha Banerjee: add a final line asking whether this is a permanent packaging change or a temporary pilot. That will affect escalation.
Marco Reyes: added. Sending now, cc procurement@redwood and claire.
Claire Donovan: @billing-bot attach contract_RW-RED-2025.pdf and invoice_2025-12.pdf to our internal thread please.
billing-bot: Attached: contract_RW-RED-2025.pdf, invoice_2025-12.pdf :white_check_mark:
Samir Gupta: Also flag finance: run a sensitivity model showing cost at 50/75/100% of current embedding growth to see overage exposure.
Isha Banerjee: I'll pull the embed counts and the event export and drop CSV here within 24 hours. If the counts show minimal usage of the new metric we can push for waiver.
Claire Donovan: Great — thanks. Please hold any renew/auto-charge until we get their response. :thumbsup:
